findings.claim: Neither T6 nor T7 pins the goal and decision-kind filters of the new pointers; dropping them leaves both tests green.
findings.evidence: A go test -overlay mutation (m2) rewrote intent_work.go:1602 to 'if q.Decision != nil || q.Goal == goalID' and goal.go:474 to 'if q.Decision != nil || q.Goal != ""'. TestIntentUnitBudgetRefusalNamesTheSpentBoxQuestion and TestGoalNextNamesASpentBoxFirst both PASS. Each test seeds exactly one question, for its own goal and of the spent-box kind.
findings.change: In T6 and T7, also seed another goal's spent-box question or this goal's breach-stop question, and assert that the refusal and goal next do not name it. Sibling place: metasystem/cmd/metasystem/goal.go:474.
findings.relation: new; rule: a pointer's filters are pinned by a test that seeds a non-matching question (test coverage below the R-124 materiality line)

findings.claim: When admission refuses with BUDGET_UNKNOWN while a spent-box question is open, the reason drops 'unreadable spending records also need repair'.
findings.evidence: intent_work.go:1599-1607 replaces nextReason for both codes once the question is found. Raising the box does not repair unreadable spending records.
findings.change: Later list: keep the repair clause when the code is BUDGET_UNKNOWN. The brief prescribes the current text, so this is not a fix for this unit.
findings.relation: new; rule: brief step 10's reason text is shared by BUDGET_REFUSED and BUDGET_UNKNOWN

findings.claim: The refusal reads InstallationRoot.Path() and goal next reads ResolveStateRoot(--root). In an adopted installation beneath its application's Git root, those are different directories.
findings.evidence: stateroot.go:183-192 returns the repository top for an installation that is not in template mode; project.go:364-385. Both roots are the ones the brief names, and afterGoalAct already uses InstallationRoot for the same store (intent_goals.go:734, :740). In this template checkout both resolve to <checkout>/metasystem. Both pointers also ignore WalkOpenQuestions' unreadable list.
findings.change: Later list: read the channel store through one resolved root in the steward, afterGoalAct, the refusal and goal next.
findings.relation: new; rule: the channel store root is one root for the asker and every reader
